name: io.github.BartWaardenburg/anwb-mcp
title: ANWB Traffic and Routes
description: ANWB traffic information, route planning, and location search for the Netherlands

environmentVariables.name: ANWB_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: locations, routes, incidents. Default: all.

environmentVariables.name: ANWB_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Cache lifetime in seconds for API responses.

environmentVariables.name: ANWB_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum retries for a failed request. Default: 3.
